name: Nearby
author: coffer team
summary: Find nearby badge owners, their X profiles and a warmer/colder signal.
description:
Find people around you with Solana OS badge radio signals. Open a profile for its public X name, bio, website and avatar, with a live warmer/colder indicator. Other badges do not need to run Nearby or X Dex. Radio discovery works offline on the same mesh channel; public profiles need Wi-Fi. Signal-based distance is a rough estimate, not GPS.

Made by Coffer team.
